title: Present Simple: Mixed Practice
description: Practice Present Simple with a mix of question types.

questions.question: Present Simple: Mixed Practice
questions.content: We use the present simple for habits, routines and facts. Remember the -s ending for he/she/it. This lesson mixes several question types — multiple choice, select-all, a dropdown, a fill-in-the-blank, a matching task and a word-order task.

questions.question: She ___ to school every day.
questions.explanation: Use -s with he/she/it in the present simple.

questions.question: Which subjects use "do" (not "does") in the present simple?
questions.explanation: "Does" is only for he/she/it. Every other subject uses "do".

questions.question: My brother ___ football on Saturdays.
questions.explanation: "Brother" is he, so the verb takes -s: plays.

questions.question: Complete the sentence: I usually ___ coffee in the morning. (drink)
questions.explanation: "I" doesn't take -s in the present simple.

questions.question: Match each subject to the verb form that matches it: "work".
questions.explanation: He/she/it take "works"; every other subject takes "work".

questions.question: Put the words in the correct order to make a present simple sentence.
questions.explanation: Present simple word order: subject + adverb of frequency + verb + object.
